entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to return some cycling shoes I recently purchased. The order number is #VF12345.
Okay, I have order #VF12345 pulled up. I see a pair of VeloFit Pro Cycling shoes. What's the reason for the return?
Well, they just don't fit right. I thought they would, but after trying them out, they're too tight.
I understand. Have the shoes been mounted with cleats?
Yes, I installed the cleats and rode with them a couple of times. I have some cleat marks on the bottom.

Thank you for letting me know. Unfortunately, because the shoes have been mounted and show cleat marks from use, we're unable to accept the return. Once cleats are installed, we cannot resell the shoes as new.
Oh, I see. What about these tires I ordered? I want to return those too.
Certainly. I see a pair of VeloFit Race Day tires on that order. Have those been used or installed on your bike?
Yeah, I mounted them and rode with them a few times, but they didn’t perform as well as I had hoped.

Unfortunately, because the tires have been mounted and used, resulting in what I imagine are dirty tires, we are unable to accept them for return either. Once tires have been installed and used, it makes them unsellable as new condition.
Oh, that's disappointing. I understand though.

I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We do have a detailed sizing guide on our website and often recommend visiting a local bike shop for a professional fitting before purchasing shoes online. Perhaps that might be helpful in the future. Also, consider buying a single tire to test before buying a full set.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help!
You're very welcome! Thank you for choosing VeloFit. Have a great day!
